# Exact advanced-crafting verdict

**REVISE through the seven finite corrections AEX-01–07 below. Conditional promotion of all 167 recipes and their 100 public projections is authorized after those corrections and the specified checks are completed. No additional generic source conference or resubmission of unchanged source records is required.**

The uncorrected archive is not approved as-is.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}[Complete exact verdict](sandbox:/mnt/data/advanced_exact_reviewer/AEX_167_Exact_Review_Verdict.md) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}[Verdict, correction register, independent audit and regression specifications](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Advanced_167_Exact_Reviewer_Verdict_and_Evidence.zip)

## Inspection and reproduced evidence

I opened the README and manifest, verified all **195 payload hashes**, and ran the validators in a separate working copy. The original archive still matches:

`a29420353145c4c91ebb472f2843a3ea14041b38eb49b93420ec99294c03b1a7`

All **138 protected source/dependency files** remain hash-identical. The included final source verdict matches the specified `48f885…c79c8e0` authority.

| Exact candidate set | Internal cards | Public cards | Recipe membership |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Enchanting | 43 | 25 | 121–159, 636–639 |
| Rune Carving | 41 | 21 | 396–432, 664–667 |
| Scribing | 40 | 28 | 471–506, 672–675 |
| Tinkering | 43 | 26 | 585–623, 684–687 |
| **Total** | **167** | **100** | **Every submitted candidate** |

All recipe numbers below carry the `recipe-` prefix.

The inspection covered every complete card/source object and manuscript, every per-card operating binding and body choice, shared operating procedures, **22 internal/15 public body variants**, **50 weapon/armor host templates**, **48 class-interface dispositions**, and **37 qualitative sequences**. The **600 original public-book paragraphs** were compared against the supplied actual DOCX text.

The supplied validators reproduce successfully: **5,770 internal checks, 1,725 public-envelope checks and 52 grouped numeric/coverage checks**. Their detailed coverage remains intact: 2,004 manufacturing rows, 519 structural contexts, 4,560 transitions, 185 chassis conversions, 410 restoration quotes, 59 maintenance packs and 36 omitted-primary inputs. My separate read-only audit produced **5,091 passing source/object/manuscript/arithmetic/projection assertions**, with the semantic findings recorded separately. These overlapping counts are not runtime or campaign-authentication evidence. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}[Independent audit](sandbox:/mnt/data/advanced_exact_reviewer/independent_audit.json)

## Accepted without reopening source authoring

**KEEP the established recipe mappings and numerical effects.** This includes all Enchanting enhancement/type/charge groups; every Rune charge, DC and effect; all 22 Scribing rank/use bindings; and all 18 automaton attacks with their authored `2+N`, `Nd6`, five-foot profiles and original printed types, HP and AC.

The five custom procedures remain separate and complete: **667 null seal, 674 Lexicon, 675 covenant Codex, 686 command relay and 687 gate ram**. They do not inherit one another’s attacks, charges, servicing or recharge rules.

**Recipe-623 is correctly bound.** Its original one-year/null-hour fields remain preserved beside the **1,920-hour ordinary / 1,440-hour eligible Forge Dwarf** completion. Its historical labor and price fields are not regenerated.

**ADV-EDIT-01 is correctly applied.** The eleven trap cards and active body/repair rules retain the original frame/discharge block while permitting compatible subordinate spring replacement. Automaton primary actuators remain primary. The corrected **two Dissonance into one device** quantity also remains correct; AEX-04 concerns the resulting disable’s incomplete description.

The four artisan creation credentials, six manufacturing bands, structural/chassis distinction, reserve histories, repair/service separation and bounded class interfaces remain controlling. No class or feat is promoted by this verdict.

## Seven required corrections

Paths below are relative to `DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/`. Corrections to cards must propagate to their active JSON fields, applicable paragraphs, `manuscriptText`, full trade manuscripts and public counterparts. Guide corrections must propagate to both the Markdown guide and embedded JSON guide text.

Preserve historical source objects, registers, verdicts and book paragraphs. Apply corrections as separately identified operational amendments.

### AEX-01 — Failure recovery: calculate the input entitlement, then cap by surviving material

**Affected:** all 167 recipes, including singleton creature-output Flawed results that use Failed recovery.

**Locations:** internal/public `operational.paragraphs[label="Retention and failure"]`, corresponding manuscripts and common failure instructions.

**Earlier rule kept:** AC-04 and the existing crafting failure rule.

Every card currently says:

> “25% of genuinely remaining consumed non-catalyst quantities … capped by actual remains.”

That can apply the percentage to the surviving remainder instead of calculating the quarter-input entitlement and then applying the physical cap.

**Replacement wording:**

> On Failed creation, for each eligible exact consumed non-catalyst input identity, recover at most one quarter of its fixed consumed-input quantity for this batch, capped by the eligible amount actually remaining from those same inputs, and rounded down once to that identity’s legal source-unit precision. Do not take one quarter of the surviving remainder. Previously returned, forfeited or lost quantities and unrelated stock cannot fund this recovery.

Use:

```text
recovered_i = u_i × floor(min(Q_i / 4, R_i) / u_i)
```

`Q_i` is the failed batch’s fixed eligible consumed-input quantity for that exact identity; `R_i` is the eligible quantity actually surviving from those same inputs; `u_i` is its existing legal precision. Preserve actual occurrence membership and existing within-batch identity grouping.

**Boundary:** recipe-480 uses five source units of Preservation treatment at 0.1 lb each. With two eligible units surviving, return **1.25 units / 0.125 lb**, not 0.50 units. With only 0.60 surviving, return **0.60 units / 0.06 lb**. Three indivisible inputs still return zero.

Catalyst exclusions, retained tools, unused bodies, division permissions and terminal-waste rules do not change.

### AEX-02 — Complete Rune control/end conditions and the known-trap disarm action

**Affected:** ordinary Rune procedures for **396–432 and 664–666**, the eight Binding cards below, and the eleven Tinkering traps below. **667 retains its distinct RC-10 activation.**

**Locations:** the public guide’s Rune Carving/Tinkering sections and corresponding active card paragraphs.

**Earlier rules kept:** RC-01, RC-02, RC-04 and TI-02.

The public guide broadens Rune examination to a “genuinely relevant INT tool check,” omits explicit known-setter disarm cost and no-automatic-rearm wording, and omits covering/Breaking from Binding termination. The Binding card paragraphs repeat that incomplete termination list. The public trap procedure also omits the setter’s one-Action disarm alternative.

**Controlling ground-Rune wording:**

> A ground plate that is moved, rotated off its declared working face, wholly covered, Broken, incomplete or suppressed cannot trigger. Restore an invalidated ground trigger only through the actual one-Action manual arming procedure on its cleared eligible square, followed by the existing next-regular-start or six-second delay; merely uncovering, repairing or unsuppressing does not rearm it. A capable authorized setter can disarm their accessible plate with an Action; physically removing it uses its actual item interaction afterward. These ground-trigger rules do not replace the specific direct-touch Healing procedure or the separate attuned-Ward duration procedure.

**Rune inspection/disarm replacement:**

> With safe access within five feet, one active minute permits an INT (Arcana) or INT check using Runecarver’s tools against the original recipe creation DC, using normal Core task shifts collapsed to success/failure. Apply only the actual applicable proficiency contribution. This examination reveals supported operating type/trigger, not donor lore, and failure grants no repeat on unchanged evidence. Disarming an unknown accessible Rune requires actual Runecarver’s-tools proficiency and tools, one active minute, and that source DC. Failure leaves it armed; it discharges only if an actual eligible entry/touch event occurs, not merely because the check failed. An unrelated tool proficiency is not a substitute.

**Binding IDs:** **396, 400, 401, 405, 412, 413, 426, 665**.

Replace their abbreviated termination sentence and the public guide’s equivalent with:

> Moving the target completely outside the original trigger square/volume, or moving, covering, suppressing or Breaking the original plate, ends this particular Binding restraint. Restoring the plate does not resume that ended restraint, refund its charge or rearm its ground trigger. Other independent restraints remain separately governed.

**Trap IDs:** **585, 588, 592, 598, 599, 601, 605, 609, 610, 613, 619**.

Add the missing public operative sentence:

> A capable authorized setter can safely disarm their accessible trap with one Action. This is distinct from the unfamiliar-trap procedure: trained thieves’ tools or Tinker’s tools, the appropriate DEX/INT method, one active minute and the printed trap save DC. Neither route grants free movement, rearming, servicing or replenishment.

**Boundary:** covering a Binding plate ends its restraint; uncovering does not resume it. Removing suppression from an invalidated ground plate does not immediately reactivate its trigger. An already active, still-unexpired **attuned Ward** retains RC-08’s different suspension/resumption procedure.

### AEX-03 — Automaton encounter service starts with actual operation

**Affected:** all 18 ordinary automata: **586, 587, 589, 590, 593, 594, 596, 600, 607, 608, 611, 612, 615, 616, 618, 620, 622, 684**.

**Locations:** public guide’s Service units paragraph, embedded guide and corresponding compact card/binding descriptions.

**Earlier rule kept:** TI-05.

The public sentence “Spend one when a genuine encounter starts” can debit an unoperated or stored machine merely because combat began.

**Replacement wording:**

> First actual operation of this automaton in a genuine encounter spends one service unit and opens that encounter’s paid operating block, lasting at most ten elapsed minutes from that operation. Mere encounter start does not debit a stored or otherwise unoperated automaton. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. Continuing operation beyond a block’s expiry needs another paid block; a distinct genuine encounter has its own service requirement. Preserve TI-05’s transition from an operating noncombat block into a genuine encounter, its no-refund/no-clock-pause rules and its physical-identity history.

Keep the existing noncombat-to-combat transition. Do not assess service per attack inside a paid block, or cancel a paid block merely because unspent service reaches zero.

**Boundary:** an unoperated packed recipe-684 loses no service unit during combat. Its first actual operation starts the block. Later suppression consumes elapsed block time without refund or extension. **686 remains on its separate winding clock.**

### AEX-04 — Routed Dissonance disables triggers and other active functions

**Affected:** all 43 TI recipes when they satisfy TD-08’s actual active-device predicate; their 26 public instances need the same rule.

**Locations:** public Tinker class-interface paragraph, embedded guide and any condensed active TD-08 description.

**Earlier rule kept:** TD-08, including the already corrected two-to-one quantity.

Replace “stops applicable movement, attacks and device aura functions” with:

> The routed disabled state prevents movement, attacks, auras, triggers and every other active device use. A routed trap cannot discharge, and a routed utility cannot provide its charged task benefit while disabled. Existing durations and paid service/winding clocks continue. Clearing the disable requires its existing specifically authorized completed removal procedure; it does not refill charges, service, RP or Refrain, erase expenditures, or grant a queued activation.

Retain **once per genuine short rest, Bonus Action, up to two current Dissonance, one own active qualifying device within 30 feet**, along with the existing removal procedures and origin-Tinker history.

AC-06 still distinguishes an invalid blocked declaration from costs already legally committed: a later disable does not refund an earlier legitimate expenditure.

**Boundary:** routing into an armed trap blocks its trigger, not merely an attack-roll action. Routing into a utility participating in a live check removes its active benefit. A buyer’s unrelated rest does not clear the originating disable.

### AEX-05 — TI-device geometry and load limits must both apply

**Affected:** **595, 602, 614, 617**; public counterparts **595 and 602**.

**Locations:** active TI-device model, public `bodyModels["TI-device"].model`, Complete output bodies paragraphs and corresponding catalogues/manuscripts.

**Earlier rule kept:** B-04.

The model string says “4x4x2 inches **or** 2 lb”; the complete body text correctly requires both.

**Canonical active model value:**

> Hand-operated bench measuring/calibration box. An admitted workpiece must both fit the actual 4 × 4 × 2-inch jaw space and weigh no more than 2 lb. These are simultaneous limits, not alternatives. No general cargo space.

Retain the historical `sourceAuthoringProfile.model` and original register. Add/use a separately identified active `operationalModelDescription`, as with the trap clarification, and project that active value consistently.

The **15-gp reference, five-pound empty body, HP/AC, envelope, primaries, hands and repair rules remain unchanged**.

**Boundary:** an oversized half-pound workpiece fails; a fitting three-pound workpiece fails. A genuinely fitting workpiece weighing at most two pounds can qualify.

### AEX-06 — Warding’s active trigger field must include saving-throw events

**Affected:** all 19 wards: **398, 402, 403, 404, 406, 407, 408, 409, 411, 414, 417, 419, 420, 421, 423, 424, 428, 431, 664**.

**Locations:** internal/public `operational.useBinding.trigger` and derived trigger summaries.

**Earlier rule kept:** RC-07.

The compact active field says “attuned bearer is targeted.” The complete procedure correctly includes saving throws from area events that need not target the bearer individually.

**Replacement value:**

> An attack legally targets the attuned bearer, or an actual event requires that bearer’s saving throw, including an area effect. The capable bearer must declare and spend one Reaction and one charge before the initiating attack or saving throw is rolled.

Preserve the historical abbreviated register field. The active binding becomes the original binding plus this named correction. Do not change enhancement, charges, positions, attunement, duration or defenses.

**Boundary:** an incoming area effect requiring a DEX save permits the pre-roll Reaction. Mere inclusion in an effect requiring neither an attack roll against the bearer nor their saving throw does not. Post-roll activation remains illegal.

### AEX-07 — Correct operative references and preserve the consultation boundary

**Locations:** affected Effect and operation paragraphs, internal/public manuscripts and the public guide’s reference legend. Protected source citations and book paragraphs remain unchanged.

| Affected recipes | Defect | Correct reference or wording |
|---|---|---|
| **22 scripts:** 471, 473–475, 480–484, 487–492, 495, 496, 499, 501, 502, 504, 505 | Consultation points to SC-04, which governs copying | “The research bonus requires the actual relevant lead consultation under **SC-05**. **SC-01–05 and SC-10** govern the full procedure.” |
| **Five references:** 476, 486, 498, 500, 672 | Full-boundaries reference omits SC-05 | “**SC-04, SC-05, SC-07, SC-08 and SC-10** provide the applicable full boundaries.” |
| **19 wards listed in AEX-06** | Six-second marker attributed to RC-07 | “Outside initiative use the **RC-08** six-second marker.” |
| **Eight Binding cards listed in AEX-02** | Placement reference omits RC-01 | **RC-01–04** |
| **Six Explosive cards:** 397, 410, 418, 429, 430, 666 | Placement reference omits RC-01 | **RC-01–03 and RC-05** |
| **Seven Healing cards:** 399, 415, 416, 422, 425, 427, 432 | Ground/direct-touch reference omits RC-01 | **RC-01–03 and RC-06** |

Retain SC-05’s scope explicitly in the public Research and navigation paragraph:

> These research/navigation bonuses apply only to their genuinely relevant recorded subject and actual eligible information task. They do not improve attacks, saves, spell DCs, spellcasting, unrelated checks, manufacture or repair. The item’s own authoring, copying or encoding, and creation of a new bonus-granting reference from that same item, receive no self-production bonus. Genuine relevant formula research remains separately eligible without guaranteeing discovery.

Provide a compact public legend mapping referenced section IDs to their corresponding **public procedure headings**. For SC-08, expose the ordinary Language Insight procedure relevant to public items, not private Lexicon membership or its dossier. Do not resolve public references by linking an unfiltered internal verdict, private body list or hidden annotations.

## Public component envelope: KEEP

This advanced envelope contains **343 component occurrences: 100 independently authorized supplemental profile occurrences and 243 withheld supplemental profile occurrences**. All printed names, quantities, roles and consumption flags remain present, as do operational precision and separate physical-occurrence requirements.

**No recipe-critical audience correction requires publishing those 243 withheld dossiers.** Each withheld occurrence is indexed to its actual recipe, and the player text explicitly requires Director verification of the exact stock before commitment. It grants no wildcard substitution, cheaper same-name replacement or free ingredient.

The admitted supplements are separately nested public material records. Their material-catalogue `category` must not overwrite the preserved recipe occurrence’s different category namespace. A public ingredient mention or profile creates no independent donor access or drop entitlement.

Keep **100 public / seven restricted / 60 Director-only recipes**, **15 public body variants**, all 50 host templates and the seven withheld private/custom body variants. All **600 original book paragraphs** remain unchanged. The identified audience corrections concern operating rules, not permission to publish private source dossiers.

## All 37 qualitative sequences

**KEEP the expected adjudications for W-01–W-19, E-01–E-16 and E-18 under their stated premises.** E-05’s intended quarter-input/surviving-cap calculation is made explicit by AEX-01; its expected result is not changed.

**E-17’s assertion of a complete public operating envelope is not satisfied by the uncorrected submission.** Retain it as the required expectation, then satisfy it through AEX-01–07 and whole-envelope regeneration. Matching JSON and manuscript strings does not establish semantic parity when both repeat the same defect.

The 22 body-boundary rows remain valid subject to AEX-05’s conjunctive TI-device limits and their actual physical premises.

These are adjudications of the supplied expectations, **not 37 executed runtime passes**. The evidence package contains an a
